high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals standing on a red carpet at what appears to be a movie premiere or similar event. The backdrop is dark blue with the words "MARTY SUPREME" prominently displayed in white capital letters, along with some stars and the logo of A24, a film distribution company. The person on the left is wearing a light gray blazer over a light blue shirt paired with a green and black striped tie. They have on white pants and brown shoes. Their posture is relaxed, with one arm casually draped around the shoulder of the person next to them.
